subject: POC hands-on workshop: scheduling, prompts & load test plan
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kristen Holt <kristen.holt@cloudtopia.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-28T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC hands-on workshop: scheduling & goals

Hi Kristen,

Great to hear CloudTopia is ready to move from the discovery call into a hands-on POC. We want the session to be practical: prompt review, routing policy demo, and a short load test to validate throughput. Proposed options (all PT):

- Tue June 15 — 09:00–11:00 (preferred)
- Wed June 16 — 13:00–15:00
- Thu June 17 — 09:00–11:00

Suggested attendees from our side: Marissa (prompt engineering lead), Jonas (serving/runtime), me (POC owner). Could you confirm the CloudTopia participants and whether IT Ops should join for the load test?

Agenda (high level):
1) 15m quick goals + success criteria
2) 45m prompt walkthrough & live editing
3) 30m routing + failover scenarios
4) 30m controlled load test (small traffic burst)
5) 15m actions & next steps

I attached a one-page agenda. If the load test requires a separate window please flag it and we’ll schedule a follow-up block.

Thanks — happy to adjust times.

Best,
Dev

Attachments: poc_workshop_agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Kristen Holt <kristen.holt@cloudtopia.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudTopia IT Ops <it_ops@cloudtopia.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T14:40:00-04:00
Subject: Re: POC hands-on workshop: scheduling & goals

Thanks, Dev — this looks good. We have a few constraints from our side:

- Ops would like the load test to run later in the day (to avoid peak production overlap).
- Our primary participants will be me (Product), Aaron Lee (ML Engineer), and our SRE lead (cc’d to this email as it_ops).

Of your proposed slots, June 15 at 09:00 PT works if we can move the load test to ~15:30 PT (or run a separate short burst at that time). Alternatively, is June 16 at 13:00 PT workable?

Also: can Marissa share the prompt templates in advance so Aaron can prep some representative examples?

-Kristen

Hi Kristen —

Thanks for the constraints and heads up on attendees. We can do one of two options:

A) Keep June 15 09:00–11:00 PT for the main hands-on session and run a 30m load-test window at 15:30 PT the same day (Jonas will drive; ops welcome to watch).
B) Move the hands-on session to June 16 13:00–15:00 PT and include the load test at 14:30 PT during the same block.

My recommendation is Option A so we keep momentum and don’t ask your team to come back on a different day. I’ll send a calendar invite for June 15 09:00–11:00 PT and a separate invite for the 15:30 load-test window.

Attachments: load_test_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Action: Marissa — can you confirm you’re available 6/15 morning and prepare the prompt deck? Jonas — can you validate the load-test checklist in the spreadsheet attached.

Cheers,
Dev

Hi all,

Quick prep note before our session on June 15: I’ve uploaded a short prompt-deck with our recommended templates and a few worked examples we’ll demo. Aaron, please glance at slide 6–9 where we list token budgets and expected latencies for the templates you mentioned.

Please review the deck and drop one example prompt you want us to iterate on into the Drive folder linked below.

If you anticipate any data access issues for the routing demo (e.g., need a specific sample dataset), let us know today and we’ll stage a sanitized set.

Date: 2026-06-15T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC hands-on workshop: scheduling & goals — session recap + next steps

Kristen / team — thanks for a productive session today. Quick recap and owners below (short version):

What we covered:
- Prompt refinement: live edits to templates A/B/C (Marissa led).
- Routing demo: policy-based routing, regional fallbacks (Jonas led).
- Load test: small burst (15:30 PT) to validate autoscaling and request queuing — results within expected thresholds.

Open actions (owners & target dates):
1) Marissa: finalize prompt set and export canonical templates (slides -> repo). Due: 2026-06-19.
2) Jonas: share full load-test logs and suggested tuning (CIY). Due: 2026-06-18.
3) Dev/CloudTopia: align on SLA targets and cost envelope for pilot (I’ll draft a short proposal). Due: 2026-06-22.
4) Aaron (CloudTopia): provide two representative data examples for routing rules (sanitized). Due: 2026-06-18.

Proposed: follow-up working session to validate tuned prompts + extended load test on Tue June 22 at 10:00 ET / 07:00 PT (60–90m). Please confirm availability and whether Ops would like an extended window for a heavier test.

Recording: https://redwood.hosting/recordings/ct-poc-20260615 (will keep for 30 days).

Attachments: session_notes_20260615.txt
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/CT-2026-0421

Thanks again — overall great alignment.
Dev
